Part D
• Errors in first step of Euler’s method:
o Incorrect form for Euler’s method step:
f (1.2) ≈ −1− (0.2)(2)
o Incorrect step size for Euler’s method:
f (1.2) ≈ −1+ (0.4)(2)
• Errors in second step of Euler’s method:
o Incorrect slope calculated for second step:
f (1.4) ≈ −0.6 + (0.2)(3 −1.4)(−0.6)2
o Incorrect step size for second step:
f (1.4) ≈ −0.6 + (1.4 −1)(1.8)(−0.6)2
• f (1.2) ≈ −1+ (0.2)(2)
• f (1.4) ≈ −0.6 + (0.2)(3 −1.2)(−0.6)2
